1200W Platinum efficiency packed into a 125 × 125 × 63.5 mm chassis. That’s 1219 W/L — server-grade power in less than 1 liter, smaller than most ATX PSUs. Designed for users who want maximum performance in minimal space.
Next-Gen Power Design — Maximum Performance & Stability
ATX 3.1 power design standards, the DAGGER PM series supports up to 200% power excursion, ensuring smooth and stable delivery even during extreme GPU load spikes.

Featuring an LLC Full-Bridge + SR + D2D architecture, it achieves ultra-stable voltage and top-tier efficiency under any load, unleashing full CPU and GPU potential for AI computing and high-performance systems.
High-performance SR MOSFETs deliver maximum power but generate extra heat, a challenge solved with advanced heat sinks in direct contact with the chassis, plus internal WR cooling.
This design ensures low temperatures, silent operation, and an extended PSU lifespan, a true mark of engineering craftsmanship.
Platinum, ensuring lower power loss, reduced heat, and quieter operation, maximizing both performance and efficiency.

The FSP DAGGER PM features an advanced semi-fanless design. The fan remains inactive under 30% load for absolute silence and operates with minimal noise even at full power. Experience high-octane performance without the distraction.
Supports most AMD and NVIDIA GPUs with a 12V-2×6 cable or up to three 8-pin PCIe connectors, ensuring clean and stable power delivery for high-end GPUs.
Equipped with two high-grade gas tubes on the PCB back, providing professional-level instant high-voltage protection. Effectively absorbs and diverts sudden lightning strikes.
Equipped with 105°C Japanese capacitors for superior reliability, stability, and extended product lifespan, even under continuous heavy load.
Soft, embossed black cables offer improved flexibility and cable management, resulting in a sleeker build aesthetic.
A full suite of safety features — OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP, SIP, NLO, safeguard your system from power surges, and unexpected voltage events.
Your components stay protected, your system runs safe and stable.
